# Codezen: smart contract and blockchain security audits

Website: https://www.codezen.tech/
Contact: info@codezen.tech

Codezen is a cybersecurity firm specializing in blockchain and Web3 technologies. It has published 122 security audits and reported 1693 vulnerabilities (204 critical) across 8 ecosystems.

## Services

### Smart Contract Audits

Enhance the security of your smart contracts with comprehensive audits that identify vulnerabilities and proactively protect against potential exploits.

### Blockchain Consulting

Receive expert guidance on building and securing your blockchain infrastructure, from architectural design to deployment and long-term optimization.

### Disaster Recovery

Guarantee business continuity with a robust Disaster Recovery plan that protects users, minimizes downtime, and ensures rapid recovery of operations.

## How Codezen works

1. Discovery: We analyze your project's requirements and unique challenges, laying the foundation for a customized security strategy.
2. Audit: We perform an exhaustive security audit, pinpointing vulnerabilities across contracts, architecture, and critical components.
3. Reporting: We deliver an in-depth report with actionable solutions to mitigate risks and fortify your project.
4. Support: We provide continuous support through implementation and keep your project protected over time.

## Audits

### Stellar Core security audit

Audit of the Stellar Core.

Codezen audited Stellar Core together with Oak Security. Technologies in scope: C++, C, Soroban, Rust and Stellar. We reported 81 findings: 2 critical, 1 major, 35 minor and 43 informational.

- Audit type: Blockchain node audit
- Technologies: C++, C, Soroban, Rust, Stellar
- Ecosystem: Stellar
- Delivered with: Oak Security
- Report date: 17 October 2025
- Full report (PDF): https://github.com/oak-security/audit-reports/blob/8a29e1d31c20fdc68bc732b1db73c4660d3fa507/Stellar/2025-10-17%20Audit%20Report%20-%20Stellar%20Core%20Protocol%2023%20Changes%20v1.0.pdf
- Project website: https://stellar.org
- Page: https://www.codezen.tech/audits/stellar-core/

#### Findings by severity

| Severity | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Critical | 2 |
| Major | 1 |
| Minor | 35 |
| Info | 43 |
| Total | 81 |
